properties.title: GRID3 COD - Health Areas v8.0
properties.description: The current version supersedes the GRID3 COD - Health Areas v7.0. The following changes were made: Added data for the provinces of Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Kwango, and Nord-Kivu. The data for Tanganyika was updated. Download province level data: Bas-Uele Equateur Haut-Katanga Haut-Lomami Haut-Uele Ituri Kasaï Kasaï-Central Kasaï-Oriental Kinshasa Kongo-Central Kwango Kwilu Lomami Lualaba Mai-Ndombe Maniema Mongala Nord-Kivu Nord-Ubangi Sankuru Sud-Kivu Sud-Ubangi Tanganyika Tshopo Tshuapa For more information on the methodology and data sources used during the production of this data, click here.

properties.ciesin:purpose: The GRID3 COD - Health Areas v8.0 dataset consists of health area boundaries with name, health zone, and other attributes for all the twenty-six provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD).
